title: The Constitution won’t save us...
text:
Stated Claim / Post Context:
The Constitution won’t save us from our own ignorance

Americans argue endlessly over who should govern. We spend less time asking the prior question: What kind of government are we trying to preserve? The answer should be self-government. What are the alternatives? Rule by someone else — by a monarch, an oligarchy, a bureaucracy, a party, an ideological elite, or simply whichever faction has […]

Actual Article Body:
Americans argue endlessly over who should govern. We spend less time asking the prior question: What kind of government are we trying to preserve?

The answer should be self-government.
